name: Template color tuning
description: Happy path: A user reviews AI-suggested vertical cover templates, opens the in-canvas Color control, and iterates through preset color palettes until they choose a final color scheme. Entry point: AI assistant panel with suggested templates visible (left). Exit point: Finalized preview on the canvas with chosen color palette and option to continue in the full editor (button: "Use Canva Editor"). Assumptions: user is in a signed-in design session with an AI assistant panel active; the canvas is editable and supports preset color palettes.
problem:
User task (user perspective): The user wants to pick and refine a vertical cover design for a "Tokyo Travel Vlog"—specifically adjusting the overall color scheme of a chosen template so the cover matches their aesthetic. They expect immediate visual feedback when switching palettes, and an easy way to continue editing in the full editor when satisfied.
System task (interface perspective): The UI provides AI-suggested templates in a left-side panel, a central canvas preview, and a Color control that surfaces a horizontal set of preset palette thumbnails. When the user selects a palette the system updates the canvas colors in real time. The system also offers a shortcut to open the full editor for more granular changes.
Result at the end:
- User-perceived outcome: The user sees the selected template updated to the chosen color scheme and can proceed to the full editor or stop after confirmation.
- System-level outcome: The design object on the canvas receives the applied palette settings (background/frames/text accents update) and remains available to open in the full editor via the "Use Canva Editor" control.

steps.name: Template preview selection
steps.goal: Review AI-suggested vertical cover templates and confirm which template to refine.
steps.action: User scans the left AI assistant panel and selects a suggested template (the highlighted thumbnail shows the current selection).
steps.system_response: The canvas displays the chosen vertical template preview with its default color scheme. The AI panel remains available with additional suggestions and an input area to ask questions.

steps.goal: Access preset color palettes to change the template's look quickly.
steps.action: User clicks the 'Color' control above the canvas, which opens a floating horizontal palette selector.
steps.system_response: A floating palette overlay appears above the canvas, showing several color-swatches / preset palettes. The canvas remains visible behind the overlay for context.
